objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has disabled Microsoft Defender utilizing PowerShell commands to include the cmdlet `Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true -Force`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: CarveyODonnellWelchHuntress_TheGentlemen_May2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also utilized the `TaskKill` command to target specific processes associated with backup software, endpoint detection, and office applications.(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
